The Edifier T5s Powered Subwoofer is a compact yet powerful audio upgrade designed to deliver deep, immersive bass for your home audio setup. Featuring an 8-inch front-firing long-throw woofer, it produces rich low frequencies down to 35Hz, making it ideal for music, movies, and gaming. With a total output power of 70W RMS, supported by a high-efficiency switching power supply and a closed-loop Class-D amplifier, the subwoofer delivers consistent, impactful bass without distortion.
Engineered for precision, the Edifier T5s incorporates a high-performance analog front end and digital signal processing (DSP) to deliver accurate sound reproduction. The built-in DSP allows fine-tuning through adjustable low-pass filtering and phase control, ensuring seamless integration with your existing speakers. Users can also customize their listening experience with dedicated controls for volume, crossover frequency, and phase alignment, making it adaptable to different room setups and audio preferences. The subwoofer is housed in a durable 18mm MDF cabinet that minimizes unwanted resonance and vibration, resulting in tighter and cleaner bass output. Its slim vertical design allows it to fit easily into compact spaces without compromising performance. For connectivity, the T5s include both Signal In and Signal Out ports, making them compatible with a wide range of devices, including desktop speakers, bookshelf systems, and home theater receivers. To enhance energy efficiency, the Edifier T5s features an auto standby function that automatically powers down after 15 minutes of inactivity and resumes operation when audio is detected. This powered subwoofer offers a balanced combination of power, precision, and convenience, making it a great choice for anyone looking to enhance their audio experience with deep and controlled bass.
